label: Автомат
description: A 10-sentence usage card for автомат (machine gun).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Автомат' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'На столе' is the prepositional location, giving a simple scene with the weapon at rest.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Автомат' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the direct object of 'чистит'. 'Свой' marks the soldier's own weapon.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Автомата' is the genitive form required after 'нет'. The frame 'у него нет' is the standard way to say someone lacks something.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из автомата' uses the genitive 'автомата' after 'из' to express the source of the shooting. A natural collocation with firearms.
Strategic focus: Accusative gift. 'Автомат' is the accusative direct object of 'дал', equal to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.

missions.phrase: Он подошёл к автомату на стене.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К автомату' uses the dative 'автомату' after 'к' to show movement toward the weapon. 'На стене' is a prepositional location.

missions.phrase: Он бежал с автоматом в руках.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental accompaniment. 'С автоматом' uses the instrumental 'автоматом' after 'с' to show what he carried. 'В руках' is a prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На автомате' uses the prepositional 'автомате' after 'на' to locate the scratch. 'Старая царапина' is the nominative subject of 'видна'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Автоматы' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Старые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в музее' is a prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Автоматы' is the inanimate accusative plural, equal to the nominative plural, as the object of 'получили'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural.
